CASH MANAGEMENT AGREEMENT 
 
 
 THIS CASH MANAGEMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement”) is entered into at ___________ , this ___________ day of ________ , 20 ____ . 
 
 
 BY AND BETWEEN 
 
 HABIB BANK LIMITED, a banking company incorporated under the laws of Pakistan, having its registered office at 9 th Floor, Habib Bank Tower, Jinnah Avenue, Islamabad and its head office at Habib Bank Plaza, I.I. Chandigarh Road, Karachi (hereinafter referred to as “HBL” which expression shall, where the context so permits or requires, mean and include its successors-in-interest, administrators and permitted assigns) of the FIRST PART . 
 
 AND 
 
 Zameen Medallion ( Pvt. ) L imi t e d , a company incorporated under the laws of Pakistan, having its office at Pearl One, 94-B/I, MM Alam Road, Gulberg III , Lahore ( hereinafter referred to as the “Customer” which expression shall, where the context so permits or requires, mean and include its successors-in-interest, administrators and permitted assigns) of the OTHER PART. 
 
 (HBL and the Customer are hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Parties” and each individually as a “Party”. ) 
 
 WHEREAS: 
 
 HBL is a banking company providing, inter alia , cash management services to its customers throughout Pakistan. 
 
 The Customer is in the business of providing digital solutions and project promotion s ervices to real estate developers with respect to their projects , including inter alia IT and IT-enabled services and other related services such as branding, A bove T he L ine and B elow T he L ine activities . 
 
 HBL has agreed to provide the Services and the Customer has agreed to procure the Services upon the terms and subject to the conditions set out in this Agreement. 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual promises and obligations set forth herein, it is hereby agreed and declared by the Parties as follows: 
 
 DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 1.1 Definitions 
 
 In this Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires, the following words and expressions shall have the following meanings: 
 
 “Agreement” shall mean this Cash Management Agreement together with its Annexures, as may be amended , from time to time , by mutual consent between the Pa rties in writing ; 
 
 “Business Day” shall mean any day on which HBL is open to customers to transact the business of banking; 
 
 “ Confidential Information ” means information that is either designated ‘confidential’ or which by its nature is clearly confidential which is provided/disclosed to the receiving P arty by the disclosing P arty in connection with this Agreement, but excludes information which ( i ) at the time of its disclosure is in the public domain as evidenced by printed publications or otherwise; or (ii) after its disclosure becomes part of the public domain by publication or otherwise through no fault of any Party or its respective nominees/employees; (iii) can be shown by conclusive written evidence as being already in a Party's possession at the time of its disclosure; and (iv) is obtained by a Party from a third party who is lawfully in possession of such information and is not subject to any contractual or fiduciary relationship that would preclude its disclosure. 
 
 “Customer’s Main Collection Account” shall mean a non- chequeing collection account which shall be opened in the name of the Customer with HBL to effect Customer collections; 
 
 “Effective Date” shall mean the date of execution of this Agreement; 
 
 “Services” shall mean the cash management services to be provided by HBL to the Customer as fully detailed in Annexure “A” ; 
 
 “Service Charges” shall mean the service charges detailed in Annexure “B” payable by Customer to HBL in consideration of the Services provided by HBL; and 
 
 “State Bank Regulations” shall mean the applicable guidelines, instructions, rules, regulations and directives of the State Bank of Pakistan in force from time to time . 
 
 1.2 Interpretation 
 
 Headings in the Agreement are inserted only for convenience and shall not affect its construction and interpretation . T he singular includes the plural, the masculine includes the feminine, and vice-versa where the context requires; a reference to any Clause or Annexure shall be construed as a reference to a clause or annexure to this Agreement . Annexures to this Agreement shall be an integral and operative part of the Agreement and any breach thereof or any misrepresentation contained therein shall entitle the Parties to the same remedies as are available in respect of other terms of this Agreement . I n case of conflict or inconsistency between any term of an Annexure of this Agreement and this Agreement, the terms of this Agreement shall prevail over the terms contained in the Annexure to the extent of the conflict / inconsistency. 
 
 SCOPE OF SERVICES 
 
 2.1 Commencing from the Effective Date, HBL shall provide the Services to the Customer in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement. 
 
 
 2.2 HBL reserves the right to accept or reject fulfilling a deposit collection/transaction request, based on such criteria as may be devised by HBL from time to time (and as may be shared with Customer at its specific request) , premised on its security and safety policies and practices, and HBL shall in no event whatsoever and to whomsoever be liable for the same. 
 
 PAYMENT OF SERVICE CHARGES &amp; EXPENSES 
 
 The Customer shall pay Service Charges in accordance with the provisions of Annexure “B” . 
 
 OBLIGATIONS, UNDERTAKINGS AND WARRANTIES 
 
 The Customer hereby undertakes, warrants and agrees with HBL that: 
 
 4.1.1 all documents and information furnished/ to be furnished to HBL by the Customer are and shall be , to the best of the Customer’s knowledge, correct, complete, and legitimate till the date of submission and shall comply with the instructions received by HBL from time to time and all prevailing laws and regulations; 
 
 4.1.2 the Customer shall as soon as practically possible inform/ notify HBL in writing of any substantial change in information provided to HBL by the Customer under this Agreement for the provision of the Services; and 
 
 4.1.3 the Customer shall be liable for all the Service Charges in respect of the provision of the Services by HBL to the Customer hereunder in accordance with Annexure “B” , and any additional bank charges and fees as notified in the Schedule of Bank Charges ( or as notified by the Bank to the Customer from time to time) ; and 
 
 4.1.4 the Customer shall notify HBL in writing of any manifest error and/or discrepancy and/or reconciliation issue in the customized management information system reports issued by HBL within ninety (90) calendar days of the date of the report issued by HBL wherein the transaction in which the error, discrepancy or reconciliation issue is recorded . Upon receipt of such notification, HBL shall at the earliest opportunity respond to the Customer in writing confirming reconciliation/resolution of the discrepancy or inform the Customer of the reasons why the reconciliation/resolution cannot be made. In the event HBL informs the Customer that the reconciliation/resolution cannot be made, the Parties shall mutually consult within a period of ___ __ days to resolve the matter. 
 
 The Customer hereby accepts and confirms that HBL may share/ furnish such information in relation to the Customer and/or the Customer ’s account , and/or the Services that are available with HBL as may be required by any authority or regulatory body in accordance with applicable law. 
 
 The Customer shall provide to HBL the names and designations of its officers/representatives who are authorized to sign instructions/mandates to HBL, to correspond with HBL, and to generally act on behalf of the Customer in regard to this Agreement. Evidence of authorization of such officers and their specimen signatures duly certified by the Customer shall be furnished to HBL before HBL commences provision of the Services. Any change in the authorized signatories of the Customer shall be notified in advance to HBL in writing at least five ( 05 ) days prior to such a change taking effect. 
 
 The Parties acknowledge and agree that this Agreement shall at all times be subject to the State Bank Regulations and all other applicable laws. 
 
 The Parties hereby represents and warrants that : 
 
 they have the full power to execute and deliver, and to perform their obligations under this Agreement and ha ve taken all necessary action to authorize the execution, delivery and performance by it of this Agreement; 
 
 this Agreement constitutes their valid and legally binding obligation, enforceable against it in accordance with its terms, except as such enforceability may be limited by bankruptcy, insolvency or other similar laws of general applicability affecting the enforcement of the Parties’ rights; and 
 
 this Agreement does not and will not conflict with or result in any breach or constitute a default under any agreement, instrument or obligation to which they are a party or by which they are bound. 
 
 HBL undertakes, represents and warrants to the Customer that HBL has and will continue to have all necessary rights, licenses, permissions and consents in connection with the Services being provided under this Agreement . 
 
 HBL represents and warrants that HBL shall at all times provide the Services in accordance with the prevalent banking industry standards and terms as agreed between the P arties . 
 
 TERM &amp; TERMINATION 
 
 5.1 This Agreement shall come into force and effect from the Effective Date and shall remain valid and in force, unless otherwise terminated earlier by either Party in accordance with the provisions of this Clause 5. 
 
 5.2 A Party hereto may terminate the Agreement without cause upon providing at least thirty (30) days’ prior written notice to the other Party, which notice shall specify the effective date of termination. 
 
 5.3 This Agreement may be terminated by either Party if the other Party is in breach of any material term and/or condition contained herein and the breaching Party shall have failed to remedy the breach within fifteen (15) Business Days of receipt of written notice specifying the breach by the non-breaching Party. 
 
 5.4 Notwithstanding anything hereinbefore contained, this Agreement may be terminated by either Party by a notice in writing to the other Party if either Party by voluntary or involuntary action or by an action of law becomes insolvent, goes into liquidation (not being a liquidation for the purpose of re-construction or amalgamation) or receivership, dissolves, files application for winding up or has a winding up order passed against it or assigns or makes any composition of its assets for the benefit of its creditors or suffers any similar action in consequence thereof. 
 
 5.5 Termination of this Agreement shall not affect the rights and obligations of the Parties that have accrued prior to termination. 
 
 INDEMNITY &amp; LIMITATION OF LIABILITY 
 
 6.1 Each Party hereby agrees to indemnify and hold the other Party (including its directors, employees, officers and agents) (together, the “ Indemnified Party ”) harmless against any and all damages, liabilities, claims, third party claims, actions, losses, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorney’s fees and costs), arising out of or related to any acts , errors or omissions of each Party with respect to its obligations under this Agreement save for those that have been proximately caused by the willful misconduct of the indemnified Party . 
 6.2 In no event shall either Party be liable for any loss of profits or business, or for any incidental, indirect, special or consequential damages/loss, howsoever arising, even if informed of the possibility of those losses or damages. 
 
 6.3 Neither Party shall be liable for any loss or damage incurred by the other Party as a result of any interruption, failure, shut down, defect or down-time (whether planned or otherwise) in any of the systems, soft-wares, applications and/or servers that may be utilized by either Party in relation to the Services. 
 
 6.4 Notwithstanding the above, in no event shall HBL’s maximum aggregate contractual and non-contractual liability to the Customer, in relation to this Agreement and in relation to provision of Services under this Agreement, ever exceed the actual aggregate amount paid by the Customer to HBL for the Services rendered from the time of commencement of this Agreement till such time as a claim (for any loss or damage) is lodged by the Customer with HBL, less any amounts which are paid out as claims by HBL to the Customer under this Agreement. 
 6.5 Notwithstanding the above, in no event shall the Customer’s maximum aggregate contractual and non-contractual liability to HBL, in relation to this Agreement and in relation to use of Services under this Agreement, ever exceed a sum equal to the value of the amount already paid to HBL by the Customer in relation to which such claim arises. 
 
 NOTICES 
 
 7.1 A notice, consent, approval or other communication under this Agreement shall be in writing, signed by or on behalf of the Party giving it and shall be delivered by messenger or reputable overnight courier or transmitted by facsimile or by authenticated swift message or by email. A notice given to a person in accordance with this Clause shall be treated as having been given and received: 
 
 on the day of delivery, if given by hand delivery and delivered before 5.00 p.m. on a Business Day, otherwise on the immediately following Business Day; 
 
 on the day of transmission, if transmitted by facsimile, swift message and/or email, and the transmission report evidences that the transmission was sent in full and without error and the transmission was completed before 5.00 p.m. on a Business Day, otherwise on the immediately following Business Day; and 
 
 on the day of actual delivery (and if such day is not a Business Day, then on the immediately following Business Day) if delivered by overnight courier.

 8. FORCE MAJEURE 
 
 8.1 If a Party hereto is affected by “force majeure” (which means any circumstances beyond the reasonable control of that Party, including, without limitation, any act of God, government or court orders, riot, strike, mob violence, lock-out or other industrial action) it shall promptly notify the other Party of the nature and extent of the circumstance leading to such force majeure. Notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, a Party hereto shall not be deemed to be in breach of this Agreement, or otherwise be liable to the other Party for any delay in performance or non-performance of any obligations under this Agreement, to the extent that the delay or non-performance is due to force majeure of which it has notified the other Party, and the time for performance of that obligation shall be extended accordingly. Where the delay in performance due to the force majeure event continues for a period of thirty (30) continuous days, the Part ies may mutually agree in writing to terminate this Agreement by written notice. 
 
 9. GOVERNING LAW 
 
 9.1 This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan. Any court of competent jurisdiction in Lahore shall have the non-exclusive jurisdiction to hear and determine any disputes between the Parties. 
 
 10. G ENERAL 
 
 10.1 All additions, amendments and variations to this Agreement shall be binding only if in writing and signed by duly authorized representatives of the Parties. 
 
 10.2 This Agreement including its annexures constitutes the entire understanding between the Parties and supersedes all previous oral and written representations, agreements or arrangements between the Parties. 
 
 10.3 Nothing contained in this Agreement shall be construed or deemed to create any association, partnership or joint venture, agency, or employer-employee relationship in any manner whatsoever between the Parties. 
 
 10.4 The Parties shall not assign whole or any part of its interest or obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the prior written consent of the other Party. 
 
 10.5 The Parties shall maintain confidentiality of the terms and conditions of this Agreement and all data and information shared under the Agreement and shall not divulge or disclose such confidential information to any person(s) who is/are not party to this Agreement unless such disclosure is required by law (to the extent permitted) and save to the extent permitted by the disclosing Party in writing, and to ensure that all Confidential Information is protected with security measures and a degree of care that would apply to its own confidential information. Notwithstanding termination/expiry of this Agreement, the confidentiality obligations shall survive till such time as Confidential Information has been either returned by the receiving Party to the disclosing Party or destroyed by the receiving Party (at the instructions of the disclosing Party). 
 
 10. 6 If any provision of the Agreement shall be or be determined to be illegal, invalid, void or voidable the legality or validity of the remainder of the Agreement shall not be affected and the remainder of the Agreement shall continue in full force and effect. 
 
 10. 7 The waiver by a Party of any breach hereof shall not be deemed a waiver of any prior or subsequent breach hereof. All remedies of a Party shall be cumulative and the pursuit of one remedy shall not be deemed a waiver of any other remedy. 
 
 10. 8 This Agreement shall be executed in two counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and both counterparts of the Agreement shall together constitute one and the same instrument.

 ANNEXURE “A” 
 
 SCOPE OF SERVICES 
 
 Customer’s Main Collection Account shall be opened at HBL, State Life Branch. 
 
 Depositors to the Customer’s Main Collection Account shall deposit funds through any of the following channels which shall be made available to depositors by HBL: 
 
 Deposits at HBL Branches 
 
 All depositors to the Customer’s Main Collection Account may deposit duly sorted cash as per the requirements of State Bank of Pakistan from time to time and instruments (such as cheques, drafts &amp; pay orders) through specialized deposit slips at HBL branches during banking business hours. The specialized deposit slips shall be designed with mutual consent of the Parties. HBL shall bear the cost and responsibility for the printing and issuance of the said s lips 
 
 Deposits through Mobile Banking , Internet Banking an
